stories.title: 'Give him the honor that he's due': Navy sailor Kenneth Lynch finally to be buried in Texas, 85 years after Pearl Harbor attack
stories.summary: The sailor, who left Denton in 1940, will be buried with full military honors next month in his hometown.

stories.title: Beaumont, Texas, man celebrates Thanksgiving milestone after yearlong battle with tumor
stories.summary: After a year with acoustic neuroma, Joseph Wheeler is regaining his ability to eat, drink, and speak and is preparing to share Thanksgiving with family.

stories.title: Why a Central Texas elementary school is using James Talarico's name in a $15K fundraiser
stories.summary: Wells Branch Elementary's PTA is highlighting its former student's political success as it struggles to raise money for field trips and student programs.

stories.title: Pflugerville residents question proposed membership prices at new recreation center
stories.summary: Pflugerville is weighing $93 monthly family memberships at its new recreation center. Residents can weigh in before a Dec. 8 vote.

stories.title: Lakeway residents voice concerns as fire station temporarily moves into neighborhood
stories.summary: The temporary move will keep firefighters in Lakeway during station construction, but some neighbors say there's been a lack of communication.

stories.summary: The district's alerts page said the lockdown was a "precautionary measure while a potential safety concern is assessed."

stories.title: Democrats flip control of Texas State Board of Education for first time in more than 30 years
stories.summary: The shift in power is expected to have big implications for what the state's 5.3 million public school students learn.

stories.title: Police investigate rising car break-ins in 2 East Austin areas, seek public’s help
stories.summary: Austin police said the break-ins have happened in two areas: on East Cesar Chavez Street near De Nada Cantina and on Comal Street near the Texas State Cemetery.
